title: Statement
description:
One release statement. The field order is the key order of the
canonical bytes.

Only `IssuedRuns::issue` builds a statement to sign, from an `Eligible`
run. Root reads one with `from_canonical`.

Asset.description: One asset of a tag: its name and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

AssetName.description:
A plain asset name: `ASSET_RE` of `handover/mcpserver.py`,
`[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]*`, at most `MAX_NAME_BYTES`.

Assets.description:
The assets of one tag: 0 to `MAX_ASSETS_PER_TAG`, sorted by name, each
name once. A `venv` or `units` tag has none (section 4.5 step 3).

Branch.description:
The ref of a statement. Check 3 of section 4.4 passes only
`refs/heads/main`, and the statement names it `main`.

CommitSha.description:
A git commit id: 40 lower-case hex digits. The recordings show a
sha1 repository. A sha256 object id is refused.

Event.description: The event of a statement. Check 2 of section 4.4 passes only a push.

ReleaseTag.description:
A release tag, `<component>-vX.Y.Z`: the component
`[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,30}` of `_TAG_RE`, then `-v`, then three numbers
of 1 to 9 digits each (section 4.5 step 4).

RepoFullName.description: A repository as `owner/name`, with exactly one slash.

RunId.description:
The API id of a Forgejo Actions run: 1 to 2^53 - 1. This is the `id` of
the run reply, not the `index_in_repo` of its `html_url`.

Sha256Hex.description: A SHA-256 digest: 64 lower-case hex digits.

SignedAt.description:
A time of a statement: whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, in the
years 1970 to 9999.

TagEntry.description: One tag of a statement with its assets.

Tags.description: The tags of a statement: 1 to `MAX_TAGS`, sorted by tag, each tag once.

WorkflowFile.description:
A workflow file name, not a path: `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*` with
the end `.yml` or `.yaml`, at most `MAX_NAME_BYTES`. The run reply
names it in `workflow_id`, for example `release.yml`.
